maps.name: halo maps
maps.model: desktop-style map app: search bar, layer panel, route panel

instruments.name: Search in words
instruments.does: “Pharmacy open now”, “quiet café”.

instruments.name: Leave-by time
instruments.does: From the next calendar event; one card on Today.

instruments.name: Route
instruments.does: Walk, transit, bike, car; step-free option.

instruments.name: Turn by turn
instruments.does: Big next-turn card; same arrow in glasses lens; buds speak turns.

instruments.name: Share arrival
instruments.does: Sends arrival time only; stops on arrival.

instruments.name: Layers
instruments.does: Transit, step-free, your photos, saved places.

instruments.name: Your photos here
instruments.does: Glasses photos pinned where taken (on this phone only).

instruments.name: Offline area
instruments.does: Download an area for no-signal use.

instruments.name: Measure distance
instruments.does: Tap points on the map.

instruments.name: Keep place
instruments.does: Adds a Place item to Library.

coach.name: halo coach
coach.model: workbook: problem on top, steps panel, answer box

instruments.name: Capture problem
instruments.does: Camera, glasses or scan; splits a sheet into questions.

instruments.name: What do you know?
instruments.does: Tap the givens; halo asks about anything missing or extra.

instruments.name: Step questions
instruments.does: One small question at a time.

instruments.name: I’m stuck
instruments.does: Makes the current question smaller; adds a picture (blocks, number line, diagram).

instruments.name: Check my thinking
instruments.does: Checks steps and units, not just the final number.

instruments.name: Answer box
instruments.does: Number pad, keyboard or handwriting.

instruments.name: Show the answer
instruments.does: Adults only, always available.

instruments.name: Try a similar one
instruments.does: New numbers, same idea.

instruments.name: Keep a card
instruments.does: From a solved problem; you approve.

instruments.name: Grown-up summary
instruments.does: Kids: what was done and what needed help. No grades or answers.

calc.name: halo calc
calc.model: desktop calculator with history tape and graph pane

instruments.name: Keys
instruments.does: Basic, scientific (S/P).

instruments.name: History tape
instruments.does: Every line kept; tap to reuse.

instruments.name: Units & currency
instruments.does: Live rates when online; marked when offline.

instruments.name: Graph
instruments.does: Plot y = …; trace points.

instruments.name: Explain this
instruments.does: Shows how a result was reached (adults); Kids open coach instead.

instruments.name: Ruler
instruments.does: Camera measures length between two points (estimate shown).

instruments.name: Level
instruments.does: Phone or glasses tilt.

instruments.name: Room outline
instruments.does: Walk the room; draws a floor outline (P).

instruments.name: Keep to Library
instruments.does: Saves a photo with the numbers.

instruments.name: Conversation
instruments.does: Two sides, each in their language; buds play the other side.

instruments.name: Camera text
instruments.does: Menus and signs translated in place; glasses lens captions.

instruments.name: Type
instruments.does: Text in, text out.

instruments.name: Offline languages
instruments.does: English and Russian on the phone by default.

instruments.name: Phrasebook
instruments.does: Kept phrases go to Library as Notes.

instruments.name: Timer
instruments.does: Visual ring; Kids version shows a shrinking picture.

instruments.name: Study blocks
instruments.does: 25/5 or your own rhythm; no streaks.

instruments.name: Quiet while focusing
instruments.does: Only people you choose can reach you.

instruments.name: What I did
instruments.does: One line kept to Today; optional.
